title: Passport

origin.publisher: Ministry of Foreign Affairs of Japan (specimen); image as published by The Japan News (Yomiuri Shimbun)
origin.title: 2025 Japanese passport, identity page specimen
origin.clearance_note: The official specimen of the identity page of Japan's 2025 passport, issued by the Ministry of Foreign Affairs. Every field is specimen data: holder 'GAIMU SAKURA' ('gaimu' means foreign affairs), passport no. ZZ0000826, with 'SPECIMEN' printed across the page; the portrait is MOFA's specimen model. No redaction needed. The request's url is The Japan News image of the specimen. That site and MOFA's own pages both block scripted downloads, so the file used is doc43-passport_japan.jpeg from the ADE Documents shared drive, at the document owner's decision; it could not be verified to be the same file as the url. It is 600x449 and shows a page curl along the top edge, as if photographed. MOFA's own specimen pages, which would be the stronger source, are https://www.mofa.go.jp/mofaj/ca/pss/pagew_000001_01518.html and https://www.mofa.go.jp/mofaj/toko/passport/pagew_000001_01253.html.

notes: The request named no feature page or fields. The first choice featured document type, passport number, issuing country, nationality and sex; at the document owner's request nationality was dropped and the date of issue added. No name is featured, although the name is specimen data. date_of_issue extracts as the ISO date 2025-03-24 and grounds to the printed '24 MAR 2025', so build_images.py flags it as not matching the boxed text; it is the same date in another format, and the crop was checked by eye. issuing_country grounds to the country name 'JAPAN' in the page header; the page's own Issuing country field prints the code 'JPN'. The supplied schema (doc43-government-id-schema.json) is used unchanged; state_issuing, eye_color, height, weight and place_of_birth are not on a passport and come back null, and state_issuing being required produces a nonconformant_output warning. Dates are normalized to ISO and flagged.
